name: garmin-mcp-ts
description: Garmin Connect MCP Server in TypeScript with Secure Encryption
long_description:
Connects Claude to a personal Garmin Connect account. It exposes activities, health and wellness metrics, sleep, training status, workouts, gear and device data as MCP tools, and can also write back to the account (workouts, manual activities, weigh-ins, gear links) when explicitly asked.

The server runs entirely on the user's machine and talks to no service other than connect.garmin.com over HTTPS. Credentials are encrypted at rest with AES-256-GCM, with the encryption key held in the operating system's native vault (Windows Credential Manager, macOS Keychain, Linux Secret Service).

tools.name: setup_credentials
tools.description: Store Garmin Connect credentials encrypted in the OS native vault and log in immediately. Use this when the server reports that credentials are missing or invalid. The password is encrypted at rest and never written to a plain text file.

tools.name: check_credentials
tools.description: Report whether Garmin credentials are configured, which source they come from, where the encrypted data is stored and whether the session is authenticated. Never returns the password.

tools.name: clear_credentials
tools.description: Delete the encrypted credentials and OAuth tokens from secure storage and end the current session. Credentials supplied through the extension settings are not affected and must be cleared there.

tools.name: list_recent_activities
tools.description: Get a list of recent activities from Garmin Connect. Returns activity summaries including name, type, distance, duration, and date.

tools.name: get_activity_details
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific activity including splits, heart rate zones, and GPS data.

tools.name: get_health_metrics
tools.description: Get daily health metrics including heart rate data and step count for a specific date.

tools.name: get_sleep_data
tools.description: Get a night of sleep: duration, sleep stages, quality score and the nightly summary. The per-minute series behind it (movement, heart rate, stress, body battery, HRV, respiration) are reported as counts only; set includeTimeSeries to inline them, or use the dedicated tool for the one series you need.

tools.name: get_body_composition
tools.description: Get body composition measurements (weight, BMI, body fat, muscle and bone mass) over a period, plus the average across the period.

tools.name: get_devices
tools.description: List the Garmin devices registered on the account with their id, model, serial and firmware version. Use get_device_settings for the configuration of a single device.

tools.name: get_user_profile
tools.description: Get user profile information: display name, user name, full name and both account ids. profileId is the one other Garmin data is keyed by (the ownerId on an activity, the userProfilePK on wellness records); id is a separate internal identifier.

tools.name: get_training_status
tools.description: Get the training status for a date: status and feedback phrase, VO2 max, fitness trend, acute and chronic training load and the acute/chronic workload ratio.

tools.name: get_steps
tools.description: Get step count for a specific date. Returns the total number of steps recorded.

tools.name: get_heart_rate
tools.description: Get detailed heart rate data for a specific date including resting HR, max HR, and HR zones.

tools.name: get_hydration
tools.description: Get daily hydration/water intake data for a specific date.

tools.name: get_workouts
tools.description: Get list of scheduled/planned workouts from Garmin Connect.

tools.name: get_activity_splits
tools.description: Get split/lap data for a specific activity including pace, distance, and time for each split.

tools.name: get_stress_data
tools.description: Get stress for a date on the 0-100 scale (0-25 resting, 26-50 low, 51-75 medium, 76-100 high). Returns average/max/min and the seconds spent in each band; set includeValues to also get the ~460 three-minute samples. The average and maximum are the day figures Garmin itself reports, so they match the Connect app; the minimum and the band seconds are derived from the samples. Use get_all_day_stress for the same day broken down hour by hour.

tools.name: get_body_battery
tools.description: Get Body Battery energy level data for a date range. Body Battery tracks energy levels (0-100) throughout the day based on sleep, stress, and activity. Shows charged/drained periods and sleep quality impact.

tools.name: get_hrv_data
tools.description: Get Heart Rate Variability (HRV) data for a specific date. HRV measures the variation in time between heartbeats, indicating recovery and stress levels.

tools.name: get_respiration_data
tools.description: Get respiration/breathing rate data for a specific date. Shows breaths per minute throughout the day and during sleep.

tools.name: get_spo2_data
tools.description: Get SpO2 (blood oxygen saturation) data for a specific date. Shows pulse oximetry readings as percentage (typically 95-100% is normal).

tools.name: get_workout_by_id
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific workout by its ID.

tools.name: download_workout
tools.description: Download a workout in FIT format for syncing to a Garmin device.

tools.name: create_workout
update_workout
tools.description: Update an existing workout (name, description, or structure).

tools.name: delete_workout
tools.description: Delete a workout from Garmin Connect.

tools.name: schedule_workout
tools.description: Schedule an existing workout on a specific date. Returns a workoutScheduleId that can be used to unschedule.

tools.name: unschedule_workout
tools.description: Remove a scheduled workout from the calendar. IMPORTANT: Always unschedule before deleting a workout to avoid ghost entries.

tools.name: upload_activity
tools.description: Upload an activity file (FIT, GPX, TCX format) to Garmin Connect.

tools.name: create_manual_activity
tools.description: Create a manual activity entry in Garmin Connect.

tools.name: set_activity_name
tools.description: Change the name of an existing activity.

tools.name: set_activity_type
tools.description: Change the type/category of an existing activity.

tools.name: delete_activity
tools.description: Delete an activity from Garmin Connect. WARNING: This action cannot be undone.

tools.name: download_activity
tools.description: Download an activity in various formats (FIT, TCX, GPX, KML, CSV).

tools.name: get_device_last_used
tools.description: Get the Garmin device that uploaded data most recently, with its id, name and upload time.

tools.name: get_device_settings
tools.description: Get settings for a specific Garmin device.

tools.name: get_all_day_stress
tools.description: Get the stress of a day hour by hour: average, maximum and stress band for each hour, plus the totals for the day. Use this to see when stress rose or fell; use get_stress_data for the day as a whole, and its includeValues for the individual three-minute samples.

tools.name: get_floors
tools.description: Get the floors climbed and descended on a date. Returns the daily totals; set includeBreakdown to also get the 96 quarter-hour intervals behind them.

tools.name: get_intensity_minutes
tools.description: Get intensity minutes (moderate and vigorous) for a date, or for a date range when endDate is given, together with the weekly totals and goal.

tools.name: get_max_metrics
tools.description: Get max metrics including VO2 max and related fitness data.

tools.name: get_training_readiness
tools.description: Get training readiness score indicating how prepared your body is for training.

tools.name: get_endurance_score
tools.description: Get endurance score based on recent training load.

tools.name: get_fitness_age
tools.description: Get fitness age estimation based on VO2 max and other metrics.

tools.name: get_weigh_ins
tools.description: Get weigh-in records for a date range.

tools.name: add_weigh_in
tools.description: Add a new weigh-in record. Weight and body fat are stored; the water, muscle and bone percentages are accepted but Garmin discards them on a manual entry, keeping them only for measurements a smart scale uploads.

tools.name: delete_weigh_in
tools.description: Permanently delete a single weigh-in record, identified by its weigh-in ID (the samplePk from get_weigh_ins or get_body_composition). The measurement cannot be recovered afterwards. Pass date when the weigh-in was back-dated to a day other than the one it was entered on.

tools.name: get_blood_pressure
tools.description: Get blood pressure readings for a date range.

tools.name: set_blood_pressure
tools.description: Record a blood pressure reading.

tools.name: delete_blood_pressure
tools.description: Delete a blood pressure reading. Use get_blood_pressure with the /all endpoint to find the version ID.

tools.name: get_activity_weather
tools.description: Get weather conditions during an activity.

tools.name: get_activity_hr_zones
tools.description: Get time spent in each heart rate zone during an activity.

tools.name: get_activity_exercise_sets
tools.description: Get exercise sets from a strength training activity.

tools.name: get_goals
tools.description: Get user goals. Without a status every status is queried in turn and the results are merged, each goal carrying the status it was found under.

tools.name: get_adhoc_challenges
tools.description: Get ad-hoc challenges history.

tools.name: get_badge_challenges
tools.description: Get available badge challenges.

tools.name: get_earned_badges
tools.description: Get all badges earned by the user, as id, key, name, category, difficulty, points and the date earned. Set includeDetails for the full badge records.

tools.name: get_personal_records
tools.description: Get all personal records (PRs). Each record carries a typeId identifying its category, its value, the date it was set and, for records set during an activity, that activity.

tools.name: get_race_predictions
tools.description: Get predicted race times for 5K, 10K, half marathon, and marathon based on current fitness.

tools.name: get_gear_stats
tools.description: Get usage statistics for a specific piece of gear. Note: Requires the gear UUID which can be found in Garmin Connect web interface URL.

tools.name: link_gear_to_activity
tools.description: Link a piece of gear to an activity. Note: Requires the gear UUID which can be found in Garmin Connect web interface URL.

tools.name: get_progress_summary
tools.description: Get aggregated progress summary between two dates.

tools.name: get_daily_summary
tools.description: Get a compact daily summary: steps and goal, calories, distance, floors, intensity minutes, resting/min/max heart rate, stress, body battery and time breakdown. Use get_heart_rate for the full heart rate series.

tools.name: get_user_summary
tools.description: Get comprehensive user activity summary for a specific date including steps, calories, distance, active minutes, and more.

tools.name: get_steps_data
tools.description: Get detailed step data chart for a specific date with timestamps.

tools.name: get_daily_steps
tools.description: Get daily step counts for a date range (max 28 days per request, auto-chunked for longer ranges).

tools.name: get_activities_by_date
tools.description: Get all activities within a date range with optional filtering by type.

tools.name: get_activity_typed_splits
tools.description: Get typed splits for an activity (more detailed than regular splits, useful for bouldering, strength training, etc.).

tools.name: get_rhr_day
tools.description: Get resting heart rate for a specific day.

tools.name: get_hill_score
tools.description: Get hill score data indicating climbing/vertical performance.

tools.name: get_all_day_events
tools.description: Get all daily events including auto-detected activities that may not have been recorded.

tools.name: get_body_battery_events
tools.description: Get Body Battery events for a date (sleep, activities, naps that affected energy levels).

tools.name: add_hydration_data
tools.description: Add hydration/water intake data in milliliters.

tools.name: get_available_badges
tools.description: Get all badges available to earn, as id, key, name, category, difficulty, points and, where set, the active window and progress. Set includeDetails for the full badge records.

tools.name: get_in_progress_badges
tools.description: Get badges that are currently in progress (started but not completed).

tools.name: get_available_badge_challenges
tools.description: Get available badge challenges to join.

tools.name: get_non_completed_badge_challenges
tools.description: Get badge challenges that have not been completed yet.

tools.name: get_in_progress_virtual_challenges
tools.description: Get virtual challenges that are currently in progress.

tools.name: remove_gear_from_activity
tools.description: Remove/unlink a piece of gear from an activity. Note: Requires the gear UUID from Garmin Connect web interface.

tools.name: get_gear_activities
tools.description: Get activities where a specific piece of gear was used. Note: Requires the gear UUID from Garmin Connect web interface.

tools.name: get_training_plans
tools.description: Get all available training plans.

tools.name: get_training_plan_by_id
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific training plan.

tools.name: get_menstrual_data
tools.description: Get menstrual cycle data for a specific date.

tools.name: get_pregnancy_summary
tools.description: Get pregnancy tracking summary/snapshot data.

tools.name: request_reload
tools.description: Request reload of data for a specific date (useful for older data that was offloaded by Garmin).

tools.name: get_activity_types
tools.description: Get all activity types available in Garmin Connect.

tools.name: get_primary_training_device
tools.description: Get information about the primary training device and device priorities.

tools.name: count_activities
tools.description: Count the activities in Garmin Connect, over the whole history or over a date range.

tools.name: get_fitness_stats
tools.description: Get aggregated fitness statistics between two dates.

tools.name: get_all_gear
tools.description: Get complete list of all gear/equipment with their UUIDs. This solves the UUID problem - you can now discover all gear without needing to manually find UUIDs in the web interface.

tools.name: update_gear
tools.description: Update existing gear/equipment details.

tools.name: delete_gear
tools.description: Delete a piece of gear/equipment. WARNING: This cannot be undone.

tools.name: get_gear_types
tools.description: Get all available gear/equipment types (e.g., Shoes, Bike, Golf Clubs, Other). Returns type names and primary keys used when creating gear.

tools.name: get_gear_makes
tools.description: Get all available gear brands/makes (e.g., Nike, Adidas, ASICS, Brooks). Returns make names and primary keys.

tools.name: get_gear_collections
tools.description: Get all gear collections. Collections group gear items that are used together (e.g., running kit, bike components).

tools.name: get_gear_collection
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific gear collection, including the gear items in the collection and associated activity types.

tools.name: create_gear_collection
tools.description: Create a new gear collection to group equipment used together (e.g., running kit, bike components). Requires a name and first use date.

tools.name: update_gear_collection
tools.description: Update an existing gear collection. Can change name, add/remove gear items, or change associated activity types.

tools.name: delete_gear_collection
tools.description: Delete a gear collection. WARNING: This cannot be undone. The gear items in the collection will NOT be deleted.

tools.name: get_activity_comments
tools.description: Get all comments on an activity.

tools.name: set_activity_privacy
tools.description: Change the privacy of an activity. "subscribers" is what Garmin Connect shows as "connections only". Read the current level from accessControlRuleDTO in get_activity_details before changing it.

tools.name: get_training_load
tools.description: Get the monthly training load balance (low aerobic, high aerobic, anaerobic) against its target ranges. This is a snapshot taken on endDate, not an aggregate over the range.

tools.name: get_load_ratio
tools.description: Get acute/chronic workload ratio indicating training balance and injury risk.

tools.name: get_performance_condition
tools.description: Get the performance condition score for a date. Garmin records this per activity rather than daily, so it is usually only available through get_activity_details.

tools.name: get_sleep_movement
tools.description: Get movement data during sleep including restless moments.

tools.name: get_device_alarms
tools.description: Get the alarms configured on a Garmin device, with time, repeat days and whether each one is on. Without a deviceId every registered device is reported.

tools.name: get_courses
tools.description: Get saved routes/courses from Garmin Connect.

tools.name: compare_activities
tools.description: Compare 2-5 activities side by side: distance, duration, speed, heart rate, calories, elevation, steps and training effect.

tools.name: find_similar_activities
tools.description: Find activities similar to a reference activity by type, distance and duration (within 20% tolerance). Returns the closest matches first, each with its full metrics and a similarity score.

tools.name: analyze_training_period
tools.description: Comprehensive analysis of training trends, volume, and patterns over a date range.

garmin_email.title: Garmin Email
garmin_email.description: The email address of your Garmin Connect account.

garmin_password.title: Garmin Password
garmin_password.description: The password of your Garmin Connect account. Stored in the operating system keychain, never in a plain text file.
